modules.description:
Adaptive finite-DEM gravity at explicit stations, with truncation bounds.

Independent Cartesian tree, signed mass groups and analytic near-field prisms.
The reported error bounds concern monopole truncation only, not DEM/density,
floating-point, datum, curvature or omitted outer-terrain uncertainty.
modules.summary: Adaptive finite-DEM gravity at explicit stations, with truncation bounds.

definitions.name: terrain_gravity_adaptive
definitions.signature: terrain_gravity_adaptive(easting, northing, elevation_m, observation_xyz, *, density_crust, density_water, reference_elevation_m, absolute_tolerance_mgal, leaf_cells=32, max_cells=4000000, max_points=100000, max_tree_nodes=1000000, max_node_visits=10000000, max_prism_evaluations=10000000, canceled=None)
definitions.description:
Finite DEM density-contrast attraction, downward positive in mGal.

Increasing uniform east/north axes (cell centres), complete 2-D DEM and
explicit ENU station positions, all metres. Above the reference plane the
contrast is crust density; below it water minus crust, no automatic datum.
Returns attraction only, NOT a complete terrain/Bouguer/tide correction.

A tree preserves separate positive/negative mass, centroids and second
central moments J. Far groups use monopoles only when d>R and the summed
bound 12*G*1e5*J/(d-R)^4 is finite. Largest-bound groups are refined until
the sum of retained bounds meets the absolute tolerance. This follows the
second-order Taylor remainder with
||Hessian(r_z/r^3)|| <= 24/r^4. The source volume lies in radius R about its
mass centre. Near leaves use exact Harmonica prism kernels, not point cells.
Tolerance zero requests all exact prisms. No thin-cell threshold is applied.

Bounds exclude roundoff and model errors, and are not statistical confidence.
Work limits cover tree nodes, visits and exact source/station evaluations,
not wall time or solver RAM. Worst case can still be a dense exact sum.
definitions.summary: Finite DEM density-contrast attraction, downward positive in mGal.

segments are correlated. No automatic flexure or causal interpretation.
definitions.summary: Welch cross-spectra: admittance=Pxy/Pxx and magnitude-squared coherence.

modules.description:
Band-limited finite-layer responses and regularized apparent properties.

Independent continuous, laterally periodic layer model, not vendor DENS/SUSC.
Rows increase north and columns east; distances are metres. Susceptibility is
SI, density contrast kg/m3, downward gravity mGal, total magnetic anomaly nT.
modules.summary: Band-limited finite-layer responses and regularized apparent properties.

definitions.name: layer_property_response
definitions.signature: layer_property_response(values, spacing, *, kind, top_depth_m, thickness_m, field_nt=None, inclination=None, declination=None, max_cells=1000000, canceled=None)
definitions.description:
Forward density contrast or induced susceptibility in a level layer.

For k>0, gravity kernel is 2*pi*G*1e5*exp(-kh)*(1-exp(-kt))/k.
Magnetic kernel is F/2*exp(-kh)*(1-exp(-kt))*d**2 with
d=sin(I)+i*cos(I)*(ke*sin(D)+kn*cos(D))/k. Susceptibility mean
produces no external response; uniform density gives the infinite-slab
response. No remanence, self-demagnetization, terrain or datum adjustment.
Complete finite periodic input; no implicit fill, detrend or padding.
definitions.summary: Forward density contrast or induced susceptibility in a level layer.

definitions.name: apparent_layer_property
definitions.signature: apparent_layer_property(values, spacing, *, kind, top_depth_m, thickness_m, background, regularization_response, max_inverse_gain, minimum_wavelength_m, field_nt=None, inclination=None, declination=None, max_cells=1000000, canceled=None)
definitions.description:
Regularized apparent contrast plus an explicitly chosen background.

Uses conjugate(K)/(|K|**2+lambda**2), with explicit inverse-gain cap and
radial shortest wavelength. lambda is in data-units/property-units;
max_inverse_gain has reciprocal units. A hard wavelength cutoff is used.
The observed mean is always removed and reported; background is prescribed
and never inferred from DC. In magnetic data it is intrinsically invisible.
At zero inclination exactly transverse modes are unobservable. Recovery
strength is returned as resolution_transfer, not geological confidence.
Does not remove IGRF/regional fields, infer geometry or estimate uncertainty.
definitions.summary: Regularized apparent contrast plus an explicitly chosen background.

Coordinates supplied to array APIs are projected metres. Maps retain source row

definitions.name: catalogue_anomalies
definitions.signature: catalogue_anomalies(grid, transform, *, threshold_nt, min_cells=3, max_features=MAX_FEATURES, canceled=None)
definitions.description:
Return signed connected features above an explicit absolute nT threshold.

Threshold applies to the provided grid values: use a residual map when the
input contains the Earth's field. Positive/negative lobes remain separate.
Diameter is the diameter of a circle with the same thresholded area; it is
not a fitted source width. Boundary flags include holes in survey support.
definitions.summary: Return signed connected features above an explicit absolute nT threshold.

definitions.name: analyze_grid
definitions.signature: analyze_grid(grid, transform, *, scales_metres=(0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 4.0), threshold_nt, min_cells=3, max_features=MAX_FEATURES, canceled=None)
definitions.description:
Return Gaussian backgrounds, residuals, signed catalogues and persistence.

Each scale is Gaussian sigma in metres, not kernel width. Mask-normalised
smoothing uses reflected outer edges and a four-sigma footprint. A residual
is input minus its local background. Both maps keep the original mask.
Persistence counts scales containing a same-polarity thresholded feature
sharing thresholded cells with each catalogue feature. It is a reproducible
detection measure, not a probability or archaeological interpretation.
Catalogue anchors include coarse-only features. Each anchor uses the first
scale where its region occurs. Broader matched lobes do not replace finer
anchors; geometries remain available separately in each scale catalogue.
Return: scale_maps list [{sigma_m, background, residual, features, ...}],
catalogue (all-scale anchors with persistence), and metadata. Arrays are float64.
definitions.summary: Return Gaussian backgrounds, residuals, signed catalogues and persistence.

definitions.name: analyze_geotiff

definitions.name: compare_feature_retention
definitions.signature: compare_feature_retention(before, after, transform, *, features=None, threshold_nt, min_cells=3, padding_metres=2.0, reference_labels=None, canceled=None)
definitions.description:
Compare anchored reference lobes on common support, without resampling.

features accepts catalogue dictionaries containing polarity and inclusive
row_min/max,col_min/max. When absent, catalogue_anomalies identifies before
lobes above threshold_nt. Expand each reference box by padding_metres and
compare extrema, half-height equivalent diameter, and fragmentation at the
same absolute threshold. Before/after grids must already share geometry and
nT units. Lost support is reported independently, not filled for comparison.
Half-height diameter uses the connected half-peak region containing the peak.
Continuity is largest threshold component / all thresholded cells in the box.
Dominant amplitude and polarity reversal refer to the unpadded reference box.
Loss of the original polarity is tested on its original threshold footprint.
reference_labels optionally supplies a grid of exact catalogue component IDs.
A missing same-polarity detection has no reported peak displacement.
definitions.summary: Compare anchored reference lobes on common support, without resampling.

definitions.name: compare_retention_geotiffs

definitions.name: compare_multiscale_retention
definitions.description:
Compare processing effects against every original residual-scale catalogue.

The after map is after_grid minus the SAME pre-processing Gaussian background
at each scale. Its background is never re-fitted, so attenuation and shifts
remain measurable in a total-field survey. Return a JSON-ready object with
scale_results and overall counts of scale/feature observations. One physical
feature can occur in several scales; counts are not unique source counts.
All geometry, metre CRS, nT units, and both source file hashes are verified.
definitions.summary: Compare processing effects against every original residual-scale catalogue.

definitions.name: magnetic_dipole_field
definitions.signature: magnetic_dipole_field(observation_xyz, source_xyz, moments_a_m2, *, minimum_distance_m, block_size=4096, max_interactions=5000000, canceled=None)
definitions.description:
ENU magnetic anomaly in nT from explicit point moments in A m2.

Positions are metres in a shared local Cartesian frame. No IGRF, coordinate
transformation, sensor calibration or regional background is subtracted.
The dipole approximation requires target dimensions small versus distance;
it does not identify shape, explosive content, or clearance status.
definitions.summary: ENU magnetic anomaly in nT from explicit point moments in A m2.

definitions.name: fit_magnetic_dipoles
definitions.signature: fit_magnetic_dipoles(observation_xyz, observed_nt, data_std_nt, initial_xyz, initial_moments_a_m2, position_lower, position_upper, moment_lower, moment_upper, *, minimum_distance_m, component='vector', inclination=None, declination=None, max_forward_calls=2000, max_total_interactions=100000000, max_nfev=100, rank_tolerance=1e-08, canceled=None)
definitions.description:
Bounded local nonlinear fit of a caller-selected number of dipoles.

Explicit seeds, position/moment bounds and positive independent data std
are mandatory. Sources must stay below every observation by the explicit
minimum distance. vector fits ENU (n,3); total fits the small-anomaly
projection along supplied grid-north I/D, not the exact total vector norm.
No regional/background term is inferred. Local covariance is conditional
on fixed geometry/noise and a linearized full-rank Jacobian, not posterior
target probability. Rank deficiency makes success false. No automatic
source-number selection, source identity, UXO/AGC classification or EM61.
definitions.summary: Bounded local nonlinear fit of a caller-selected number of dipoles.

definitions.description:
Fit measured = gain*reference + offset, four real parameters by GLS.

Reference is exact and in the SAME phasor convention as measured. Covariance

definitions.name: clean_crosshatch_levels
definitions.signature: clean_crosshatch_levels(first_df, second_df, *, x_column, y_column, value_column, track_column, sensor_column, time_column, canceled=None, progress=None, workflow='crosshatch', baseline_mode='sensor_profile', on_no_crossovers='raise', max_segments=1000000, max_crossings=500000)

Return two copied frames and a JSON-safe relative-levelling QC report.

Time must be numeric and use the same unit within each input. Rows retain

values. Each track/sensor pair is one order-zero correction profile. Its
geometry follows source order and breaks at invalid samples, non-increasing
time, or a time gap exceeding twice its median positive sampling interval.

Cancellation raises InterruptedError and never edits caller-owned frames.
definitions.summary: Return two copied frames and a JSON-safe relative-levelling QC report.

Normalized secondary voltage V/V at times OR rectangular mean gates.

Infinite charged step-off by default. A finite positive on-pulse begins
at -pulse_duration_s and switches off at zero. 'dc' uses fully charged
primary voltage; 'pulse' uses primary immediately before that switch-off.
Cole-Cole relaxation is Mittag-Leffler, not a stretched exponential.
definitions.summary: Normalized secondary voltage V/V at times OR rectangular mean gates.

definitions.description:
Validate an (n, 4) integer electrode-index table; -1 means remote B/N.

All real electrodes must be distinct within each quadrupole. In half
space all used finite electrodes must lie on the same horizontal plane.
definitions.summary: Validate an (n, 4) integer electrode-index table; -1 means remote B/N.

definitions.name: geometric_factor
definitions.description: Signed K = 2*pi/(1/AM-1/BM-1/AN+1/BN); full space uses 4*pi.
definitions.summary: Signed K = 2*pi/(1/AM-1/BM-1/AN+1/BN); full space uses 4*pi.

definitions.name: apparent_resistivity
definitions.description: Preserve polarity; flag negative apparent rho instead of taking abs.
definitions.summary: Preserve polarity; flag negative apparent rho instead of taking abs.

definitions.name: reciprocal_errors
definitions.description:
O(n) reciprocal grouping with polarity correction and repeat counts.

Swapping A/B or M/N flips resistance. Repeats in each orientation are
averaged first; error = 200*abs(Rf-Rr)/(abs(Rf)+abs(Rr)). Same-orientation
repeats alone are not reciprocals. Unpaired/zero pairs return NaN.
definitions.summary: O(n) reciprocal grouping with polarity correction and repeat counts.

definitions.name: integrated_chargeability
definitions.description:
Trapezoidal time-average decay/primary, mV/V, with exact gate edges.

Piecewise linear interpolation at gate boundaries; no extrapolation.
This is normalized average chargeability, NOT an unnormalized ms integral.
Last axis is time. Sign is preserved, primary voltage must be nonzero.
definitions.summary: Trapezoidal time-average decay/primary, mV/V, with exact gate edges.

definitions.name: cole_cole_resistivity
definitions.description:
Pelton resistivity, exp(+i*omega*t): rho0*(1-m+m/(1+(i*w*tau)**c)).

Low-frequency rho0; high-frequency rho0*(1-m). Negative imaginary part
for passive polarization under this convention. No conductivity-model
parameter conversion is implied.
definitions.summary: Pelton resistivity, exp(+i*omega*t): rho0*(1-m+m/(1+(i*w*tau)**c)).

modules.description:
Budgeted SimPEG DC and linearized static IP on 2.5D/3D tensor meshes.

Mesh coordinates: (x,z) for a y=0 survey in 2.5D, (east,north,up) for 3D.
Electrodes always use ENU triples in metres; no snapping/draping occurs.
Conductivity S/m, unit-current DC transfer resistance ohms, IP chargeability
V/V. Active cells represent the supplied terrain; inactive air is 1e-8 S/m.
No automatic CRS/datum conversion, mesh design or geological interpretation.
modules.summary: Budgeted SimPEG DC and linearized static IP on 2.5D/3D tensor meshes.

definitions.name: electrical_forward
definitions.signature: electrical_forward(mesh_widths, mesh_origin, electrodes, abmn, conductivity_s_m, *, active_cells=None, parameter_labels=None, chargeability_v_v=None, nky=11, max_cells=5000, max_parameters=5000, max_work=20000000, max_jacobian_elements=2000000, cancel=None)
definitions.description:
DC resistance or LINEARIZED static apparent IP, tensor-mesh PDE.

With chargeability_v_v, fixed DC conductivity and small-chargeability
linearization are used. This is not a full Cole-Cole time/frequency decay.
Air/topography are supplied by active_cells; mesh design and convergence
remain caller responsibilities. No data or geometry is silently draped.
definitions.summary: DC resistance or LINEARIZED static apparent IP, tensor-mesh PDE.

definitions.name: ip_sensitivity
definitions.signature: ip_sensitivity(mesh_widths, mesh_origin, electrodes, abmn, *, conductivity_s_m, active_cells=None, parameter_labels=None, nky=11, max_cells=5000, max_parameters=32, max_work=20000000, max_jacobian_elements=2000000, cancel=None)
definitions.description:
Normalized static-IP sensitivity for quasi-static dispersive-IP models.

Rows follow ABMN and columns follow prescribed active cells/zones. Fixed
conductivity/geometry, small-polarization approximation; no EM induction.
definitions.summary: Normalized static-IP sensitivity for quasi-static dispersive-IP models.

definitions.name: invert_electrical
definitions.signature: invert_electrical(mesh_widths, mesh_origin, electrodes, abmn, observed, *, data_std, initial, reference, beta, kind='dc', conductivity_s_m=None, active_cells=None, parameter_labels=None, regularization=None, bounds=None, nky=11, max_cells=5000, max_parameters=256, max_work=20000000, max_jacobian_elements=2000000, max_evaluations=30, max_forward_evaluations=100, cancel=None)
definitions.description:
Bounded regularized DC log-sigma or static-IP eta inversion.

DC initial/reference/bounds use S/m; IP uses V/V with supplied fixed
conductivity_s_m. beta and reference are mandatory. Default regularizer
is identity in parameter space (NOT spatial smoothing or cell-volume
weighting); caller may supply a physical prior operator explicitly.
Optional parameter_labels define contiguous piecewise-constant zones.
Dense Jacobians are budgeted; this is not an industrial matrix-free solve.
Sparse LU is deliberate and independent of the potential-field Jacobi
solver. Cancellation is between PDE solves, not inside native factorization.
definitions.summary: Bounded regularized DC log-sigma or static-IP eta inversion.

modules.description:
Standalone, budgeted equivalent-source interpolation and continuation.

Harmonica's Cartesian 1/r equivalent sources, not a physical density model.
Caller supplies source locations, damping and target heights; no fixed-height
FFT assumption. No extrapolation uncertainty or geological uniqueness claim.
modules.summary: Standalone, budgeted equivalent-source interpolation and continuation.

definitions.name: equivalent_source_predict
definitions.signature: equivalent_source_predict(observation_enu_m, values, source_enu_m, target_enu_m, *, damping, max_kernel_elements=5000000, prediction_block_size=1024, cancel=None)
definitions.description:
Fit an explicit source layer and predict arbitrary observation surfaces.

Damping is positive or None (unregularized). Reject coincident sources and
observation/target points. Training is dense and budgeted, predictions are
blocked. Caller must validate damping and geometry using independent held-
out data; fitted residuals are not a continuation accuracy certificate.
definitions.summary: Fit an explicit source layer and predict arbitrary observation surfaces.

modules.description:
Optional quasi-static 3D FDEM, tensor meshes, nonmagnetic isotropic media.

Metres ENU, S/m, Hz, magnetic-dipole moment A m^2 and SECONDARY B in teslas.
No displacement current, anisotropy, chargeability or automatic terrain/mesh
design. Small parameterized fits, not industrial matrix-free voxel inversion.

definitions.name: fdem_3d_forward
definitions.signature: fdem_3d_forward(mesh_widths, mesh_origin, frequency_hz, conductivity_s_m, *, source_m, receiver_m, active_cells=None, parameter_labels=None, moment_a_m2=1.0, source_axis='z', receiver_axis='z', air_conductivity_s_m=1e-08, max_cells=2000, max_unknowns=8000, max_parameters=2000, max_work=500000, cancel=None)
definitions.description:
SimPEG electric-field formulation, analytic magnetic-dipole source.

One transmitter/receiver per frequency row; common triples broadcast.
Inactive cells are explicit air, active zones may have arbitrary 3D geometry.
No hidden snapping or primary-field normalization/ppm. Source and receiver
must stay inside the mesh; boundary distance and discretization convergence
are caller responsibilities. LU fill-in is NOT bounded by work estimates.
Cancellation is checked between frequency solves, not inside sparse LU.
definitions.summary: SimPEG electric-field formulation, analytic magnetic-dipole source.

definitions.name: fit_fdem_3d_zones
definitions.signature: fit_fdem_3d_zones(mesh_widths, mesh_origin, frequency_hz, observed_secondary_b_t, *, real_std_t=None, imag_std_t=None, data_covariance_t2=None, initial_conductivity_s_m, reference_conductivity_s_m, beta, source_m, receiver_m, active_cells=None, parameter_labels=None, bounds_s_m=(1e-06, 10.0), max_evaluations=20, max_forward_evaluations=80, max_parameters=16, cancel=None, **forward_options)
definitions.description:
Bounded local 3D zone fit with explicit log-conductivity L2 prior.

Finite-difference Jacobian, counted forward-call budget including Jacobian
evaluations. Not scalable voxel inversion. Supply independent real/imag
standard errors OR data_covariance_t2 for [real,imag] per record, not both.
Records are independent: shared-calibration cross-record errors are NOT
represented by marginal 2x2 covariances. Geometry/source/air are fixed, no mesh
refinement. beta/reference are mandatory; beta=0 explicitly disables prior.
definitions.summary: Bounded local 3D zone fit with explicit log-conductivity L2 prior.

modules.description:
Cartesian static elastic thin-plate flexure with explicit periodic boundaries.

D nabla^4 w + delta_rho*g*w = pressure, w positive DOWN. Uniform elastic
thickness and restoring contrast, no membrane stress, viscosity or load feedback.
Input is prescribed net pressure in Pa, NOT unlabelled topography/density.
modules.summary: Cartesian static elastic thin-plate flexure with explicit periodic boundaries.

definitions.name: thin_plate_flexure
definitions.signature: thin_plate_flexure(load_pa, spacing_m, *, elastic_thickness_m, young_modulus_pa, poisson_ratio, restoring_contrast_kg_m3, gravity_m_s2=9.80665, max_cells=1000000, cancel=None)
definitions.description:
Static periodic elastic response to a complete prescribed pressure grid.

FFT axes are row-northing and column-easting, spacing (dy,dx) in metres.
Rigidity D=E*Te^3/[12*(1-nu^2)] in N m. No taper/padding, mean removal or
missing-load filling. Zero thickness gives local pressure/(delta_rho*g).
Mean load remains compensated at every thickness. Edges repeat periodically;
design a regional load domain and check domain/refinement sensitivity.
definitions.summary: Static periodic elastic response to a complete prescribed pressure grid.

definitions.signature: scan_elastic_thickness(load_pa, observed_down_m, observation_std_m, spacing_m, *, candidate_thicknesses_m, young_modulus_pa, poisson_ratio, restoring_contrast_kg_m3, gravity_m_s2=9.80665, observation_mask=None, max_cells=1000000, max_work=50000000, cancel=None)
definitions.description:
Explicit finite thickness scan against DOWN-positive displacement, not gravity.

Conditional independent Gaussian data errors, fixed load/material/density.
Returns the full misfit curve, best supplied candidate, ties and edge flags;
not geological Te uncertainty, continuous optimization or an inferred prior.
Mask can exclude missing observations, never missing pressure cells. No offset
is fitted, no mean is removed. A uniform load contains no Te information.
definitions.summary: Explicit finite thickness scan against DOWN-positive displacement, not gravity.

Caller supplies projected metric coordinates and an explicit covariance model.

definitions.name: empirical_variogram
definitions.signature: empirical_variogram(coordinates, values, lag_edges_m, *, max_pairs=200000, seed=0, azimuth_deg=None, angular_tolerance_deg=90.0, canceled=None)
definitions.description:
Classical half-squared-difference lag means, complete or sampled pairs.

For large surveys, sample independent uniform ordered distinct-index pairs

are not counts of independent data. Direction is axial, clockwise from north.

exact interpolation, including nugget; this is not nugget-error smoothing.
A positive search radius leaves unsupported queries as NaN. A zero radius
permits extrapolation, which is disclosed, not a confidence certificate.
Shared neighborhoods reuse factorizations; distinct-system and element
budgets prevent silently constructing a survey-size dense solve.
definitions.summary: Local ordinary kriging with declared parameters and conditional variance.

modules.description:
Anchored land-gravity network adjustment and density regression.

Readings are calibrated mGal, times seconds. Drift is per instrument/session;
different sessions must have different IDs. No tide, instrument scale or
height correction is fabricated. Known station anchors are exact constraints.
modules.summary: Anchored land-gravity network adjustment and density regression.

definitions.name: adjust_gravity_network
definitions.signature: adjust_gravity_network(station_ids, instrument_ids, times_s, readings_mgal, reading_std_mgal, *, anchors_mgal, anchor_std_mgal=None, drift_degree=1, max_elements=2000000)
definitions.description:
Weighted station+instrument-offset+polynomial-drift adjustment.

A single reading equation is reading=g_station+offset_inst+drift_inst(t).
Times are centered/scaled per instrument for conditioning; coefficients
use normalized time. Rank deficiency/disconnected unanchored components
are errors. Formal covariance assumes independent absolute reading errors;
Anchors are exact unless anchor_std_mgal supplies a positive standard
deviation per anchor; then anchor observations enter the GLS system and
their uncertainty propagates to all station and drift estimates. Anchor
errors are independent of each other and of instrument readings. Correlated
reference/instrument errors require an explicitly different noise model.
definitions.summary: Weighted station+instrument-offset+polynomial-drift adjustment.

definitions.name: fit_bouguer_density
definitions.description:
Fit g=rho*effect+nuisance*coeff, with explicit unit-density correction.

Parasnis-style regression; effect must be supplied consistently from the
chosen slab/terrain model. Default nuisance is an intercept. Geological
signals correlated with topography bias the estimate; uncertainty is only
conditional WLS, not evidence for a unique physical subsurface density.
definitions.summary: Fit g=rho*effect+nuisance*coeff, with explicit unit-density correction.

modules.description:

Integrate polygon edges analytically; horizontal edges need no perturbation.

Simple concave polygons and either vertex order are supported. Holes require
separate negative-contrast bodies. Overlapping bodies add their contrasts.
Limits count station-edge interactions, not just rectangular grid size.
definitions.summary: Integrate polygon edges analytically; horizontal edges need no perturbation.

definitions.name: fit_polygon_densities
definitions.signature: fit_polygon_densities(observation_xz_m, polygons_xz_m, observed_mgal, reading_std_mgal, *, fit_offset=False, maximum_condition=100000000.0, max_elements=2000000, max_interactions=20000000, canceled=None)

rescaling. Rank deficiency is rejected instead of returning arbitrary masses.
definitions.summary: Known-error GLS density contrasts, fixed geometry, optional constant offset.

definitions.name: MinimumCurvatureGridder
definitions.description:
Independent finite-difference minimum-curvature interpolation.

Briggs constraints couple off-node observations to curvature. Natural
discrete energy boundaries and grid-unit
tension are defined by this solver.
boundary_mode="linear_ghost" optionally applies experimental zero normal
curvature at the two outer ghost rings (multilevel, zero tension only).
Multilevel iteration uses the seed, refinement and pass controls. The
optional variational solver records the controls it does not use.

blanking_metric='cell_manhattan' is a cell-based blanking mode. It rounds each input location
to the nearest output cell and measures Manhattan distance between cell
indices.  The regular euclidean and manhattan modes retain their
continuous-coordinate semantics.

definitions.name: fixed_l2_reference
definitions.signature: fixed_l2_reference(sensitivity, observed, data_std, regularization, *, beta, reference_model=None, max_elements=2000000)
definitions.description:
Small dense augmented-SVD oracle; fixed physical L2 prior, no bounds.

Minimize ||Wd(Gm-d)||**2 + beta*||L(m-mref)||**2 without forming normal
equations. This optimum need not equal the generating geological model.
definitions.summary: Small dense augmented-SVD oracle; fixed physical L2 prior, no bounds.

definitions.name: linear_error_partition
definitions.description:
Volume-weighted row/null partition for small linear sensitivity matrices.

Numerical null space is determined by machine-rank SVD, not a geological
resolution cutoff or a nonlinear IRLS posterior. Weak nonzero modes remain
in the row space and must be inspected through the singular spectrum.
definitions.summary: Volume-weighted row/null partition for small linear sensitivity matrices.

definitions.name: linear_resolution
definitions.description:
Gaussian linear covariance and resolution with fixed beta and L.

G maps physical model parameters to physical data, Wd=diag(1/std).
Precision=G.T*Wd**2*G+beta*L.T*L; resolution=precision^-1*G.T*Wd**2*G.
The prior must make precision positive definite. This is NOT a nonlinear
posterior, spatial DOI, or a covariance valid after adaptive IRLS/beta.
definitions.summary: Gaussian linear covariance and resolution with fixed beta and L.

definitions.name: reference_model_doi
definitions.description:
Signed reference-model sensitivity (ma-mb)/(ra-rb), no clipping.

Both inversions must use the same parameterization, data and misfit
settings. This conventional reference comparison is not a universal
geological depth cutoff. Cells with insufficient reference contrast are
invalid, rather than silently assigned zero or infinity.
definitions.summary: Signed reference-model sensitivity (ma-mb)/(ra-rb), no clipping.

modules.description:
Explicit off-period stacking for a finite ideal-switch IP current history.

The caller selects actual switch-off events, sample/gate delays, cycle weights
and the stacking convention. No waveform detection or instrument recipe is
inferred. Fixed sensitivity optionally maps prescribed zones to ABMN records.
modules.summary: Explicit off-period stacking for a finite ideal-switch IP current history.

definitions.name: stack_ip_decay
definitions.signature: stack_ip_decay(event_times_s, current_a, off_event_indices, *, stack_mode, times_s=None, gates_s=None, stack_weights=None, normalization='pulse', chargeability=0.1, tau_s=1.0, exponent=0.5, sensitivity=None, cancel=None)
definitions.description:
Predict a stack of explicitly selected zero-current off-periods.

stack_mode is mandatory: mean_of_ratios averages per-cycle V/V curves;
ratio_of_sums divides polarity-aligned weighted raw secondary and primary
voltage sums (therefore accounts for absolute on-current amplitudes).
Delays are relative to each selected switch-off; gates may not cross the
next on-switch. Optional sensitivity requires one [m,tau,c] triple per zone.
definitions.summary: Predict a stack of explicitly selected zero-current off-periods.

definitions.name: fit_ip_stack
definitions.signature: fit_ip_stack(event_times_s, current_a, off_event_indices, observed_v_v, *, stack_mode, times_s=None, gates_s=None, stack_weights=None, normalization='pulse', initial, standard_deviation, reference=None, beta=None, sensitivity=None, lower=(0.0, 1e-09, 0.1), upper=(0.5, 1000000000.0, 1.0), **solver_options)

Fit intrinsic [m,tau_rho,c] to an explicitly specified stacked response.

Observations/errors are already stacked V/V. No raw-voltage processing or
automatic uncertainty reduction is inferred. With sensitivity, initial and
reference are (n_zones,3), and reference must be supplied explicitly.
definitions.summary: Fit intrinsic [m,tau_rho,c] to an explicitly specified stacked response.

modules.description:
Current-source Cole-Cole IP after a prescribed finite current history.

Piecewise-constant current, initially unpolarized before the first switch.
All observation times/gates follow the final switch to zero at t=0.
No transmitter ramps, receiver transfer function, induction or steady-periodic
prehistory is inferred. Spatial calculations use fixed static-IP sensitivity.
modules.summary: Current-source Cole-Cole IP after a prescribed finite current history.

definitions.name: ip_waveform_decay
definitions.signature: ip_waveform_decay(event_times_s, current_a, *, times_s=None, gates_s=None, chargeability=0.1, tau_s=1.0, exponent=0.5, normalization='pulse', cancel=None)
definitions.description:
Off-time secondary V/V for a finite signed current-switch history.

event_times_s ends at 0; current_a is current immediately AFTER each switch.
Current is zero before the first event and after the last event. Times/gates
are relative to the final switch-off. Normalization dc uses rho0 times the
final signed on-current; pulse uses the predicted final pre-switch primary.
definitions.summary: Off-time secondary V/V for a finite signed current-switch history.

definitions.name: fit_ip_waveform
definitions.signature: fit_ip_waveform(event_times_s, current_a, observed_v_v, *, times_s=None, gates_s=None, initial, standard_deviation, reference=None, beta=0.0, normalization='pulse', lower=(0.0, 1e-09, 0.1), upper=(0.95, 1000000000.0, 1.0), **solver_options)

Observations and their errors are V/V with the selected primary convention.
Only post-final-off observations are supported; no stacking is inferred.
definitions.summary: Fit intrinsic m, resistivity tau and c using the complete current history.

modules.description:
Cartesian Airy root models with explicit boundaries, independent of QGIS.

Coordinates and heights are metres; density is kg/m3; g_z is downward in mGal.
The caller supplies a complete regional load model independently of stations.
Prisms use a finite domain; the Parker FFT method repeats its input domain.
Neither adds a spherical correction or a fitted offset.
modules.summary: Cartesian Airy root models with explicit boundaries, independent of QGIS.

definitions.name: airy_prisms
definitions.signature: airy_prisms(easting, northing, basement, *, reference_depth=30000.0, density_crust=2670.0, density_mantle=3070.0, water_thickness=0.0, density_water=1040.0, block_size=1, max_cells=100000)
definitions.description:
Build root/antiroot prisms, optionally averaging loads in square blocks.

Water thickness is explicit (including lakes above sea level). NoData in a
load model is an error, never implicitly zero mass. Block averaging preserves
integrated compensating mass, but changes geometry: test convergence.
Axes must be regularly spaced, ascending cell centres, with >=2 values.
definitions.summary: Build root/antiroot prisms, optionally averaging loads in square blocks.

definitions.name: airy_root_effect
definitions.signature: airy_root_effect(coordinates, prisms, density, *, chunk_size=512, max_interactions=200000000, progress=None, cancelled=None, gravity_backend=None)
definitions.description:
Evaluate finite roots at arbitrary stations, retaining missing stations.

Bounded chunks allow progress/cancellation. A work limit counts actual
station/prism pairs instead of restricting raster dimensions. Pass an
explicit larger limit only after benchmarking. Missing model masses are
prohibited in airy_prisms; missing station coordinates yield NaN.
definitions.summary: Evaluate finite roots at arbitrary stations, retaining missing stations.

definitions.name: airy_root_effect_fft
definitions.signature: airy_root_effect_fft(basement, spacing, *, boundary, reference_depth=30000.0, density_crust=2670.0, density_mantle=3270.0, water_thickness=0.0, density_water=1040.0, observation_height=0.0, tolerance_mgal=1e-05, max_terms=64, max_cells=4000000, cancelled=None)
definitions.description:
Parker-series root gravity at a horizontal observation plane (mGal).

spacing is (dx, dy) in metres. Rows/columns and output retain input order.
boundary='periodic' is required explicitly: the rectangle repeats to
infinity, including its mean load. No zero padding, taper, demeaning or
fitted constant is applied. This is a different physical boundary condition
from finite prisms, not an acceleration of that same finite model.

The root extends from depth D to D+t with density -(mantle-crust).
Its transform is -2*pi*G*contrast*exp(-k*(D+z)) times
sum[(-k)**(n-1) * FFT(t**n)/n!]. The k=0 term is retained.
Convergence requires max(abs(t)) < D+z. Three consecutive small terms
are required; their magnitude is a numerical diagnostic, not a model error.
Returns (effect, diagnostics). Missing regional load is always rejected.
definitions.summary: Parker-series root gravity at a horizontal observation plane (mGal).

definitions.name: tem_stepoff_layered
definitions.signature: tem_stepoff_layered(times_s, conductivity_s_m, thicknesses_m, *, source_m, receiver_m, moment_a_m2=1.0, source_axis='z', receiver_axis='z')
definitions.description:
Point-time dB/dt (T/s) following an ideal magnetic-dipole step-off at 0.

The source is on from minus infinity. This does not approximate a finite
ramp, arbitrary waveform, finite loop or instrument receiver convolution.
definitions.summary: Point-time dB/dt (T/s) following an ideal magnetic-dipole step-off at 0.

definitions.name: tem_gate_average
definitions.signature: tem_gate_average(gates_s, conductivity_s_m, thicknesses_m, *, quadrature_order=6, waveform_times_s=None, relative_current=None, **geometry)
definitions.description:
Boxcar time average of dB/dt by Gauss-Legendre quadrature.

Gates may overlap but must start after 0. Integration accuracy must be
checked by increasing quadrature order for wide gates/fast transients.
Default is ideal step-off. Both waveform arrays select a finite piecewise
linear waveform instead; see tem_waveform_layered for their conventions.
definitions.summary: Boxcar time average of dB/dt by Gauss-Legendre quadrature.

definitions.name: tem_waveform_layered
definitions.signature: tem_waveform_layered(times_s, conductivity_s_m, thicknesses_m, *, waveform_times_s, relative_current, source_m, receiver_m, moment_a_m2=1.0, source_axis='z', receiver_axis='z')
definitions.description:
dB/dt T/s for an explicit normalized piecewise-linear dipole waveform.

Waveform knots increase strictly, end at t=0 with current=0 and precede
all positive observation times. Relative currents lie in [-1,1] and
multiply moment_a_m2 (peak dipole moment, NOT current in amperes).
Current before the first knot remains at its first value; use initial
zero plus a turn-on ramp to model a finite pulse, not infinite on-time.
No receiver response, finite loop or automatically repeated pulses.
definitions.summary: dB/dt T/s for an explicit normalized piecewise-linear dipole waveform.

definitions.name: fit_tem_conductivity
definitions.signature: fit_tem_conductivity(observed_dbdt_t_s, *, data_std_t_s, initial_conductivity_s_m, thicknesses_m, times_s=None, gates_s=None, waveform_times_s=None, relative_current=None, quadrature_order=6, bounds_s_m=(1e-06, 10.0), max_evaluations=60, max_forward_evaluations=300, cancel=None, **geometry)
definitions.description:
Bounded log-conductivity fit of signed point-time OR gate TEM data.

Fixed layer thicknesses/geometry/waveform, independent explicit errors,
no regularizer or automatic DOI. Supply exactly one of times_s/gates_s.
Forward-call budget counts finite-difference Jacobian calls too. A hard
budget violation raises RuntimeError; optimizer limit returns success=False.
This is local 1D fitting, not spatially constrained or 3D inversion.
definitions.summary: Bounded log-conductivity fit of signed point-time OR gate TEM data.

definitions.name: fit_fdem_conductivity
definitions.signature: fit_fdem_conductivity(frequency_hz, observed_secondary_b_t, *, real_std_t, imag_std_t, initial_conductivity_s_m, thicknesses_m, bounds_s_m=(1e-06, 10.0), max_evaluations=60, cancel=None, **geometry)
definitions.description:
Bounded log-conductivity fit, fixed known layers/geometry, no regularizer.

Errors for real/imag data must be positive and externally supplied. This
local least-squares fit is not unique geological inversion, LCI or 3D EM.
Success and termination are explicit; evaluation limit is not success.
definitions.summary: Bounded log-conductivity fit, fixed known layers/geometry, no regularizer.

modules.description:
Band-limited potential-field component conversion and gradient integration.

Complete, periodic level grids in ENU coordinates; rows increase northward,
columns eastward. North-up raster rows must be oriented by the caller.
No fill, padding, detrend,
field direction or vertical datum is inferred. Results are not unique geology.
modules.summary: Band-limited potential-field component conversion and gradient integration.

definitions.name: convert_field_component
definitions.signature: convert_field_component(values, spacing, *, input_component, output_component, output_mean_nt, inclination=None, declination=None, damping=0.0, max_gain=100.0, max_cells=4000000, canceled=None)
definitions.description:
Convert total/east/north/up/down anomaly components in nT.

Total means the SMALL-ANOMALY projection onto a constant reference field,
not |B0+b|-|B0|. Inclination is positive down, declination clockwise from
grid north in degrees. Both are mandatory whenever total is involved.
A source-free harmonic half-space is assumed. At nonzero wavenumber,
E/D=i*ke/k, N/D=i*kn/k, U/D=-1, T/D=sin(I)+i*cos(I)*(ke*sin(D)+kn*cos(D))/k.
The inverse uses conjugate(input)/(|input|^2+damping^2), then a dimensionless
gain cap. Unobservable and even-grid Nyquist modes are set to zero and
counted. The output DC mean must be explicitly supplied, never inferred.
definitions.summary: Convert total/east/north/up/down anomaly components in nT.

definitions.name: reconstruct_tmi_from_gradients
definitions.signature: reconstruct_tmi_from_gradients(spacing, *, reference_mean_nt, gradient_east=None, gradient_north=None, gradient_up=None, weights=None, damping_wavenumber=0.0, max_cells=4000000, canceled=None)
definitions.description:
Weighted spectral least-squares integration of TMI derivatives (nT/m).

At least one gradient is required. Weights are positive relative weights
by east/north/up, not estimated covariance. The ridge wavenumber is rad/m.
Operators are i*ke, i*kn, -k; the vertical gradient MUST be positive up.
Returned field is nT. The DC datum is supplied by the caller. Unobservable
modes and Nyquist rows/columns are zero, not observations or recovered data.
Predictions and residual RMS permit consistency checks on supplied gradients.
definitions.summary: Weighted spectral least-squares integration of TMI derivatives (nT/m).

definitions.name: stochastic_linear_resolution
definitions.signature: stochastic_linear_resolution(sensitivity, data_std, regularization, *, beta, probe_count=64, seed=0, method='rademacher', cg_rtol=1e-08, cg_maxiter=1000, precision_diagonal=None, max_elements=20000000, max_matvecs=200000, canceled=None)

Gaussian prior is required. Bounds and learned regularizers are excluded.

definitions.name: tabulated_radial_filter
definitions.signature: tabulated_radial_filter(values, spacing, wavenumbers_rad_per_m, gains, *, max_abs_gain, max_cells=4000000, canceled=None)
definitions.description:
Filter a complete periodic level grid using a real radial gain table.

Spacing is (northing,easting) metres. Table wavenumbers are angular rad/m,
increasing from zero. Linear interpolation is explicit; the last gain is
retained above the last tabulated wavenumber. A gain at zero changes the
mean. Negative gains reverse sign, not a phase-recovery operation. The
caller supplies a finite positive gain budget; values beyond it are
rejected, not clipped. No fill, padding or hidden normalization is applied.
definitions.summary: Filter a complete periodic level grid using a real radial gain table.

modules.description:
Measured spectrometer response and first-order calibration uncertainty.

No automatic pad geometry, height, live-time, aircraft, cosmic or radon correction.

modules.summary: Measured spectrometer response and first-order calibration uncertainty.

definitions.name: fit_radiometric_response
definitions.signature: fit_radiometric_response(known_concentrations, window_rates, rate_covariance, *, component_names, concentration_units, window_names, maximum_condition=10000000000.0, max_elements=2000000)
definitions.description:
Fit rates = concentration @ sensitivity.T + offset by full GLS.

All standards must be comparable in geometry/exposure/corrections. Known
concentrations are exact, not errors-in-variables. Covariance across windows
is supported; covariance across standard records is not. Coefficient order
is window-major [sensitivities to all components, offset], repeated per window.
No positivity constraints or clipping; inspect negative sensitivities.
definitions.summary: Fit rates = concentration @ sensitivity.T + offset by full GLS.

definitions.name: radiometric_concentrations
definitions.signature: radiometric_concentrations(window_rates, rate_covariance, *, calibration, max_samples=3000000, max_output_elements=50000000, block_size=4096, maximum_condition=100000000.0, cancel=None)
definitions.description:
Invert a square calibrated window response and propagate uncertainty.

Delta-method first-order covariance includes measured rates AND sensitivity/
offset uncertainty. Survey measurements must be independent of calibration
records. Returns marginal per-record covariance, not cross-record covariance:
a shared calibration creates correlated errors between survey points.
Negative estimates remain marked. No conversion of eU/eTh to true elemental
abundances, radioactive-equilibrium assertion or implicit altitude correction.
definitions.summary: Invert a square calibrated window response and propagate uncertainty.

modules.description:
Calibrated two-detector radon proxy with a temporal Gaussian prior.

This is an explicit linear model, NOT automatic radon concentration estimation
or reproduction of a proprietary/full IAEA processing recipe. Instrument,
cosmic and live-time corrections and measured response coefficients are
external inputs. Do not infer calibration coefficients from unknown geology.
modules.summary: Calibrated two-detector radon proxy with a temporal Gaussian prior.

definitions.name: paired_detector_radon
definitions.signature: paired_detector_radon(times_s, downward_u_rate, upward_u_rate, *, downward_std, upward_std, downward_radon_response, upward_ground_response, upward_radon_response, roughness, covariance_down_up=0.0, segment_ids=None, max_samples=3000000)
definitions.description:
Joint terrestrial U-window rate and calibrated radon proxy versus time.

Model d=g+alpha*r, u=beta*g+gamma*r. Rates already corrected for non-radon
backgrounds; supplied alpha/beta/gamma define r units (NOT Bq/m^3 unless
independently calibrated). Errors are Gaussian, per-record covariance is
allowed; different times are independent in the likelihood.

Prior penalty roughness*sum((r[i+1]-r[i])**2/delta_t), within contiguous
segments only. roughness=0 gives the exact per-record 2x2 inverse. Returned
variances are marginal posterior variances CONDITIONAL on fixed noise,
coefficients and roughness, not frequentist smoothing standard errors.
Negative estimates remain flagged, never clipped. O(n) tridiagonal solve.
definitions.summary: Joint terrestrial U-window rate and calibrated radon proxy versus time.

modules.description:
Full-spectrum count processing; NumPy/SciPy only, no survey assumptions.

Inputs are raw nonnegative counts, never already stripped concentrations.
No aircraft, atmospheric radon, dead-time or height correction is inferred.
Noise estimates below assume independent Poisson raw channel counts.
modules.summary: Full-spectrum count processing; NumPy/SciPy only, no survey assumptions.

definitions.name: energy_rebin
definitions.description:
Conservative overlap rebinning, assuming uniform density within a bin.

Counts outside target support are reported, not redistributed. Fractional
rebinning produces correlated channels. variance_diagonal alone does NOT
describe the output covariance; rebin_matrix preserves the full operator.
Cov(out)=A*diag(raw_counts)*A.T for each independent raw-count spectrum.
definitions.summary: Conservative overlap rebinning, assuming uniform density within a bin.

definitions.name: fit_energy_calibration
definitions.description:
Linear E=offset+gain*channel fit with optional absolute energy errors.

At least three peaks allow a residual check; two are insufficient for
assessing nonlinearity. Returns covariance in (offset, gain) order.
definitions.summary: Linear E=offset+gain*channel fit with optional absolute energy errors.

definitions.name: poisson_nasvd
definitions.description:
Uncentered noise-adjusted SVD with separable Poisson expected counts.

E[count(i,j)]=exposure(i)*mean_rate(j). Whiten by sqrt(E), truncate at
caller-selected rank, then unwhiten. Zero-total channels/rows stay zero.
Negative reconstructions are flagged, NOT clipped. Noise whitening is
estimated, so singular values are not a universal rank/significance test.
The explicit matrix budget prevents accidental survey-scale dense SVD.
definitions.summary: Uncentered noise-adjusted SVD with separable Poisson expected counts.

definitions.name: integrate_energy_windows
definitions.description:
Fractional energy-window counts and complete plug-in Poisson covariance.

Covariance accounts for shared raw bins even between overlapping windows.
Windows must be contained in the calibrated spectrum support. Fractional
bin weights presume uniform within-bin count density.
definitions.summary: Fractional energy-window counts and complete plug-in Poisson covariance.

definitions.name: linear_covariance_transform
definitions.description:
Propagate a fixed calibration/stripping operator and full covariance.

Operator uncertainty itself is not included. Negative stripped estimates
remain negative; clipping would change the uncertainty model.
definitions.summary: Propagate a fixed calibration/stripping operator and full covariance.

definitions.name: fit_full_spectrum
definitions.description:
Weighted nonnegative template fit, response=(channels, components).

Response must already include exposure and calibration; include background
templates explicitly. Requires externally justified positive uncertainties
(not sqrt(0) or automatically fabricated uncertainties). Conditional
active-set covariance is not a full nonnegative Bayesian posterior.
definitions.summary: Weighted nonnegative template fit, response=(channels, components).

definitions.name: mnf_denoise
definitions.signature: mnf_denoise(training_spectra, noise_covariance, rank, *, spectra=None, max_elements=5000000, maximum_noise_condition=10000000000.0)
definitions.description:
Noise-whitened linear MNF, retaining caller-selected high-SNR modes.

Rows are spectra, columns share channel units. Supply a stationary SPD
noise covariance in those units squared, independently measured or modeled.
Raw Poisson counts are heteroscedastic: a single noise covariance is not
automatically valid; use suitable normalization/calibration or NASVD.
Training determines the mean and rotations; optional spectra are held-out
data transformed without refitting. Eigenvalues are total/noise variance,
descending; no automatic rank or significance interpretation.
Negative reconstructed values are flagged, never clipped. Output noise
covariance is conditional on this fixed trained transform, not uncertainty
in the covariance estimate, selected rank or changing instrumental noise.
definitions.summary: Noise-whitened linear MNF, retaining caller-selected high-SNR modes.

modules.description:
Calibrated airborne radon separation; no guessed detector coefficients.

IAEA-TECDOC-1363 (2003), section 5.5.6: upward-window and full-spectrum
mixture models. Outputs retain signed estimates and conditional uncertainty.
The methods do not convert a radon proxy into Bq/m3 without external calibration.
modules.summary: Calibrated airborne radon separation; no guessed detector coefficients.

definitions.name: upward_window_radon
definitions.signature: upward_window_radon(upward_u_rate, downward_u_rate, downward_th_rate, rate_covariance, coefficients, *, coefficient_covariance=None, max_samples=3000000, block_size=4096, canceled=None)
definitions.description:
IAEA upward-detector equation with six supplied calibration constants.

Rate order: upward U, downward U, downward Th, already corrected for
instrument/cosmic background. Coefficients: a1,a2,au,at,bu,bt, where
up_radon=au*down_U_radon+bu and down_Th_radon=at*down_U_radon+bt.
The terrestrial upward contribution is a1*U_ground+a2*Th_ground.
Covariances may be shared or per record; coefficient covariance is shared.
Measurement/calibration errors must be independent. Shared coefficients
correlate records; only marginal per-record covariance is returned.
definitions.summary: IAEA upward-detector equation with six supplied calibration constants.

definitions.name: calibrated_window_radon
definitions.signature: calibrated_window_radon(window_rates, rate_covariance, response_matrix, *, radon_component=3, max_samples=3000000, maximum_condition=100000000.0, block_size=4096, canceled=None)
definitions.description:
Separate four calibrated window components, including atmospheric radon.

Input shape (records,4), response (windows,components), fixed known response.
A possible basis is continuum-corrected low-Bi, K, U and Th windows with
columns K/U/Th/Rn. This is a general calibrated window mixture, not a claim
that arbitrary low-energy sums reproduce the IAEA continuum-subtracted L.
Output covariance includes correlation from estimating and subtracting radon
from those same measurements. Shared calibration uncertainty is excluded.
definitions.summary: Separate four calibrated window components, including atmospheric radon.

definitions.name: full_spectrum_radon
definitions.signature: full_spectrum_radon(spectra, response_matrix, rate_std, component_names, *, radon_component=3, maximum_condition=100000000.0, max_elements=5000000, canceled=None)
definitions.description:
Signed weighted full-spectrum separation with a calibrated radon template.

spectra=(records,channels), response=(channels,components), std shared per
channel or per record. Spectra and templates must share energy calibration,
rate/exposure convention and geometry. Independent Gaussian channel errors
are explicit inputs, never invented from zero counts. Correlated rebinned
bins need a separate covariance-aware likelihood; this API rejects that
noise model by contract. Coefficients are allowed negative and flagged.
definitions.summary: Signed weighted full-spectrum separation with a calibrated radon template.

modules.description:
Truth-based model recovery assessment, separate from data-fit/solver success.

Criteria are caller-declared before a campaign. Truth belongs to validation,
never automatically to a production inversion's prior or parameter selection.
modules.summary: Truth-based model recovery assessment, separate from data-fit/solver success.

definitions.name: model_recovery_metrics
definitions.signature: model_recovery_metrics(coordinates_enu_m, cell_volumes_m3, recovered, truth, *, criteria, connectivity_radius_m=None, connectivity_edges=None, support_fraction=0.5, vector=False, max_cells=20000, max_links=200000, canceled=None)
definitions.description:
Assess location, volume, support, contrast, direction and volume-weighted L2.

Scalars use (n,) properties, vectors use cell-major ENU (n,3). All properties
must share physical units. Support threshold is support_fraction times the
maximum TRUE amplitude, used for scoring only. Connected components use an
either an explicit center-distance radius or caller-supplied cell-adjacency
edges. The radius is not an adaptive-mesh face topology; explicit edges let
a caller supply that topology without falsely fragmenting coarse cells.
Predicted/truth component centroids are matched by minimum total distance.
Count mismatch, missing/fragmented bodies and undefined direction fail the
requested recovery criteria. Contrast/direction use recovered values in
true body regions; other criteria jointly penalize leakage/displacement.
Output is a deterministic benchmark assessment, not confidence/probability.
definitions.summary: Assess location, volume, support, contrast, direction and volume-weighted L2.

modules.description:
Normalized cell-difference prior, with the SimPEG 0.15 weight convention.

The modern physical-gradient prior remains separate. This is a mathematical
compatibility definition, not a claim of identical IRLS/optimizer trajectories.

Definition reference: SimPEG 0.15.0 regularization/sparse.py and
regularization/regularization_mesh.py (MIT, SimPEG developers). The public
Discretize stencils are projected onto active cells/faces here; no legacy SDK
or private survey is required at runtime. Core allocation guards apply first.
modules.summary: Normalized cell-difference prior, with the SimPEG 0.15 weight convention.

definitions.name: build_cell_difference_prior
definitions.signature: build_cell_difference_prior(mesh, active, reference, norms, alphas, reference_in_smooth=False)
definitions.description:
Build a scalar prior with dimensionless cell-stencil coefficients.

Sensitivity weights replace volume weights, as in the historical Sparse
convention. Face weights average cell-weight PRODUCTS before multiplying
IRLS face weights. This differs from multiplying separately averaged
volume/sensitivity arrays on an adaptive mesh. The complete objective is
twice the historical half-quadratic objective, consistent with current
SimPEG's data-misfit normalization. L2 and frozen L1 derivatives are checked
against independently generated historical-library snapshots.
definitions.summary: Build a scalar prior with dimensionless cell-stencil coefficients.

modules.description:
Prescribed electrical sources and reference networks, not fluid-flow inference.

Metres, S/m, amperes and VOLTS. Green functions assume constant isotropic
conductivity and full space or an insulating horizontal surface z=0. No
streaming-potential coefficient or hydraulic model is inferred from SP alone.
modules.summary: Prescribed electrical sources and reference networks, not fluid-flow inference.

definitions.name: prescribed_source_potential
definitions.signature: prescribed_source_potential(observation_m, reference_m, source_m, current_a, *, conductivity_s_m, space='half', max_elements=2000000)
definitions.description:
V(observation)-V(reference) from neutral prescribed point-current sources.

Current conservation sum(I)=0 is required. Surface image sources impose
zero normal current at z=0. These equivalent point currents are not a
calibrated electrokinetic, redox or ore-body interpretation.
definitions.summary: V(observation)-V(reference) from neutral prescribed point-current sources.

definitions.name: invert_source_currents
definitions.signature: invert_source_currents(observation_m, reference_m, source_m, voltage_v, *, voltage_std_v, conductivity_s_m, beta, space='half', max_elements=2000000)
definitions.description:
Regularized linear equivalent-current estimate with exact neutrality.

Last source balances all others; identity L2 prior acts on the independent
currents, so prior depends on that explicit parameterization. Supplied
source geometry and conductivity are fixed. No unique hydraulic inference.
definitions.summary: Regularized linear equivalent-current estimate with exact neutrality.

definitions.name: adjust_reference_network
definitions.signature: adjust_reference_network(pairs, voltage_v, *, voltage_std_v, node_count, anchors_v, max_elements=2000000)
definitions.description:
WLS electrode-node potentials from oriented differences V[a]-V[b].

Anchors are exact known node potentials. Detect disconnected/underdetermined
networks; retain loop residuals. This is network adjustment, not a fabricated
time-dependent electrode-drift or telluric correction.
definitions.summary: WLS electrode-node potentials from oriented differences V[a]-V[b].

modules.description:
Prescribed self-potential currents in a finite heterogeneous 3D conductor.

SimPEG cell-centred finite volumes; -div(sigma grad(phi))=q, q A/m^3.
All exterior faces are insulating. Conductivity is fixed, isotropic, positive
per cell. No air/topography masking, electrokinetic inference or open infinity.
modules.summary: Prescribed self-potential currents in a finite heterogeneous 3D conductor.

definitions.name: sp_pde_forward
definitions.signature: sp_pde_forward(mesh_widths, mesh_origin, conductivity_s_m, source_density_a_m3, observation_m, reference_m, *, max_cells=10000, max_data=100000, cancel=None)
definitions.description:
Potential differences from neutral prescribed cell currents in 3D.

q is A/m^3, conductivity S/m, mesh metres ENU, arrays in discretize Fortran
cell order. Positive q injects current and increases local potential.
No Robin/open boundary: all six sides are insulating, not an infinite
half-space. Check domain sensitivity before interpreting a survey.
Electrodes must lie within cell-centre bounds, with no implicit snapping.
definitions.summary: Potential differences from neutral prescribed cell currents in 3D.

definitions.name: fit_sp_pde_sources
definitions.signature: fit_sp_pde_sources(mesh_widths, mesh_origin, conductivity_s_m, source_templates_a_m3, observation_m, reference_m, observed_v, data_std_v, *, reference_coefficients, beta, regularization=None, max_cells=10000, max_data=100000, max_parameters=32, max_elements=2000000, cancel=None)
definitions.description:
Linear Gaussian fit of prescribed neutral source-template amplitudes.

Conductivity/geometry fixed. Templates are A/m^3 per unit coefficient, each
individually neutral. beta and reference coefficients mandatory; beta>0,
L defaults to identity (not spatial smoothing). Signed amplitudes, no bounds.
One PDE factorization shared by source RHS blocks. Dense sensitivity budgets
and conditional covariance; NOT inversion of conductivity, hydraulic head,
coupling coefficients or a unique geological/electrokinetic source model.
definitions.summary: Linear Gaussian fit of prescribed neutral source-template amplitudes.

modules.description:
Euler, Werner and profile SPI source-depth estimators, independent of QGIS.

Projected coordinates and all heights/depths must use one length unit. Elevations
and vertical derivatives are positive upwards. See docs/source_depth.md for the
geometry assumptions, quality statistics and primary references.
modules.summary: Euler, Werner and profile SPI source-depth estimators, independent of QGIS.

modules.description:

definitions.name: spherical_optimizer
definitions.description:

The SDK's separate critical gradient floor must not override the requested
tolerance. Only after an unsuccessful Armijo search, retry with angular
components capped at pi/4. If clipping destroys descent, use a feasible
diagonal-gradient direction. Already accepted Newton steps are preserved.
Neither safeguard changes the objective, bounds or data.
definitions.summary: Projected GN with a descent-preserving angular trust-step safeguard.

definitions.name: spherical_pcg
definitions.description:

modules.description:
Independent grid texture and basic monogenic phase attributes.

These are mathematical feature maps, not geological faults or a CET clone.
Grid axes are increasing north by row and east by column, in projected metres.
modules.summary: Independent grid texture and basic monogenic phase attributes.

definitions.name: monogenic_phase_attributes
definitions.signature: monogenic_phase_attributes(values, spacing, wavelengths_m, *, sigma_on_f, noise_threshold, polarity='both', padding_cells=(0, 0), edge_exclusion_cells=0, max_cells=1000000, canceled=None)
definitions.description:
Log-Gabor/Riesz phase symmetry and unweighted phase alignment.

All inputs must be finite; NoData are not filled. Wavelengths and bandwidth
are explicit. noise_threshold has the input field units, is subtracted
from accumulated energies, and is NOT an automatic Rayleigh noise model.
Basic phase alignment is local energy / summed scale amplitudes, without
frequency-spread weighting or Kovesi's phase-deviation penalty. This is not
numerical parity with phasecongmono or CET. Even-grid Nyquist axes and
frequencies above the minimum directional Nyquist are excluded.
Padding is reflected only when explicitly requested. Edge exclusion is
recorded, not an inferred scientifically valid boundary. Normal azimuth
is axial, clockwise from grid north, and NaN where odd energy is unresolved.
definitions.summary: Log-Gabor/Riesz phase symmetry and unweighted phase alignment.

definitions.name: local_grid_texture
definitions.signature: local_grid_texture(values, window_size, value_range, *, bins=32, minimum_valid_fraction=1.0, max_cells=1000000, max_bin_cells=64000000, require_valid_center=True, canceled=None)
definitions.description:
Local standard deviation (input units) and quantized entropy (bits).

The quantization range and odd square window are explicit. Values outside
the range are rejected, not silently clipped. NaN neighbours are omitted
and counted; centres with NaN or insufficient window coverage remain NaN.
Outside-grid support is absent, not reflected or fabricated. Entropy
depends on bins/range/window and is not a lithological classification.
definitions.summary: Local standard deviation (input units) and quantized entropy (bits).

definitions.name: local_orientation_entropy
definitions.signature: local_orientation_entropy(azimuth_degrees, window_size, *, bin_origin_degrees, bins=18, minimum_count=3, max_cells=1000000, canceled=None)
definitions.description:
Axial orientation entropy of sampled directions, not contact density.

Azimuth is clockwise from grid north, modulo 180 degrees. NaN means no
orientation sample. Bin origin is explicit because quantized entropy is
sensitive to bin placement. Statistics can be supported at empty centres
by neighbouring samples; this does not fill any measured field. Each sample
has equal weight, not line length or geological confidence. minimum_count
governs support; orientation entropy does not establish structural genesis.
definitions.summary: Axial orientation entropy of sampled directions, not contact density.

definitions.name: stack_transients
definitions.description:
Polarity-corrected mean, sample standard deviation and SEM per sample.

Rows are independent repeat transients, columns are samples or gates.
polarity is an explicit +/-1 per row. accepted is an optional boolean
shot mask; no automatic outlier rejection. NaNs mark missing individual
samples, zeros remain observations. Too few contributions yields NaN.
SEM assumes independent repeats: it excludes correlated/telluric noise,
instrumental bias, waveform uncertainty and timing jitter.
definitions.summary: Polarity-corrected mean, sample standard deviation and SEM per sample.

definitions.name: gate_recorded_transients
definitions.description:
Exact boxcar means of piecewise-linearly interpolated recorded samples.

Time is the last axis. Gates are contained in the sampled interval, with
explicit edges in seconds. No extrapolation or center-sample approximation.
NaN in a sample contributing to a gate propagates to that gate; it is not
filled with zero. Gate each repeat BEFORE stacking to retain within-shot
temporal correlation in empirical gate noise. The returned sparse weight
operator also supports external covariance propagation W*C*W.T.
definitions.summary: Exact boxcar means of piecewise-linearly interpolated recorded samples.

definitions.description:

definitions.name: explicit_time_gain
definitions.signature: explicit_time_gain(traces, dt_s, *, reference_time_s, power=0.0, exponential_rate_s=0.0, max_gain)
definitions.description:

definitions.summary: Apply g(t)=(1+t/tref)^power*exp(rate*t), capped at explicit max_gain.

definitions.name: fit_diffraction_hyperbola
definitions.signature: fit_diffraction_hyperbola(positions_m, travel_times_s, *, time_std_s, initial, velocity_bounds_m_s, max_evaluations=100)
definitions.description:
Fit zero-offset point-diffractor t^2=t0^2+4*(x-x0)^2/v^2.

Explicit (x0,t0,v) initial guess and velocity bounds. Homogeneous velocity,
zero antenna separation, flat datum; not a general CMP/tomographic model.
Covariance is local conditional least-squares, excluding pick/model bias.
definitions.summary: Fit zero-offset point-diffractor t^2=t0^2+4*(x-x0)^2/v^2.

definitions.name: normal_moveout
definitions.signature: normal_moveout(traces, dt_s, offsets_m, velocity_m_s, *, maximum_stretch, minimum_fold=2)
definitions.description:
Constant-RMS-velocity reflection NMO and mean stack on a zero-based axis.

Offset is full source-receiver separation: t=sqrt(t0^2+(offset/v)^2).
Mute unsupported/stretched samples; no amplitude/stretch compensation.
This is an array processor, not automatic velocity analysis or migration.
definitions.summary: Constant-RMS-velocity reflection NMO and mean stack on a zero-based axis.

definitions.name: hvsr_windows
definitions.description:
Unsmoothed per-window H/V using RMS of north/east amplitude spectra.

Shape (window,3,time), component order north,east,up. Hann periodogram,
mean removed, H=sqrt((P_N+P_E)/2), V=sqrt(P_U). Caller-supplied vertical
noise floor in input-unit^2/Hz; invalid ratios remain NaN. Geometric mean
and log spread describe accepted windows, NOT uncertainty in Vs/depth.
No SESAME certification, smoothing, response removal or automatic rejection.
definitions.summary: Unsmoothed per-window H/V using RMS of north/east amplitude spectra.

definitions.name: sta_lta_picks
definitions.signature: sta_lta_picks(traces, dt_s, *, sta_samples, lta_samples, threshold, lta_energy_floor, search_window_s)
definitions.description:
First causal trailing energy-ratio crossing in an explicit search window.

Integer STA<LTA; startup before a complete LTA is invalid. Output is a
candidate threshold pick, NOT a calibrated phase classifier or uncertainty.
Filter/detrend, verify polarity/timing and manually review before tomography.
definitions.summary: First causal trailing energy-ratio crossing in an explicit search window.

definitions.name: phase_velocity_image
definitions.signature: phase_velocity_image(traces, dt_s, positions_m, velocities_m_s, *, frequency_range_hz, minimum_amplitude, minimum_traces=3, max_work=5000000)
definitions.description:
Phase-shift coherence image for positive apparent velocity on a line.

Uniform increasing receiver spacing; output |mean(exp(i*phase))|^2.
Demeaned Hann-tapered FFT amplitudes divided by sample count. Reject weak
spectral traces using the caller's explicit amplitude floor. Nyquist-alias
cells are masked. This is dispersion imaging, NOT mode picking or Vs
inversion; negative propagation/array geometry need a different contract.
definitions.summary: Phase-shift coherence image for positive apparent velocity on a line.
